# Stone Line

> Stone Line is a premium natural stone company based in Cristești, Mureș County, Romania (operated by Davalex SRL). With over 20 years of experience, it sources, fabricates, and installs natural stone — marble, granite, travertine, andesite, and slate — for residential and commercial projects, alongside restoration and specialist consultation services. The site is bilingual (Romanian primary, English secondary for the main pages); the blog is in Romanian only.

## Company
- Legal entity: Davalex SRL, trading as Stone Line
- Address: Str. Principală 563B, Cristești, Mureș, Romania
- Contact: [Contact page](https://stone-line.ro/contact) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/contact-en)) — WhatsApp: +40 365 402 379
- Hours: Mon–Thu 10:00–17:00, Fri 10:00–16:00

## Materials
- [Marmură / Marble](https://stone-line.ro/marmura) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/marmura-en))
- [Granit / Granite](https://stone-line.ro/granit) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/granit-en))
- [Travertin / Travertine](https://stone-line.ro/travertin) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/travertin-en))
- [Andezit / Andesite](https://stone-line.ro/andezit) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/andezit-en))
- [Ardezie / Slate](https://stone-line.ro/ardezie) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/ardezie-en))

## Services
- [Montaj piatră naturală / Natural stone installation](https://stone-line.ro/montaj-piatra-naturala) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/montaj-piatra-naturala-en))
- [Restaurare piatră naturală / Natural stone restoration](https://stone-line.ro/restaurare-piatra-naturala) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/restaurare-piatra-naturala-en))
- [Consultanță / Specialist consultation](https://stone-line.ro/consultanta) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/consultanta-en)) — free, no obligation
- Custom pieces cut from slabs (countertops, window sills, steps, vanity tops): see [piese personalizate](https://stone-line.ro/blog/piese-personalizate-piatra-naturala/)
